item.title: Meta workers can opt out of being tracked at work up to 30 min
item.description:
📝 In April the company received criticism from its own staff after it announced a new tool would log their keystrokes and mouse clicks to train its AI models. Meta has laid off around 2,000 employees this year. This change came after reports that employees were finding the tool consumed so much data it was causing their internet usage to surge when working from home.
